'''Stormtrooper Defense of Hoth''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Stormtrooper (GPN)|Stormtrooper]]
* '''Published:''' 5 September 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Home One: Docking Bay|DS2-L-homeonedockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Home One: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Home One Docking Bay Stormtrooper L.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

All my Charakters are unique.

Most of them have permanent Weapons.

The published list has 59 cards.
